Several days (missions 1–6: 4–8 hours; mission 7: several team sessions)

{npc:Henricus} leads the Inquisition in Thais and recruits you to rid Tibia of demons. You interrogate guards, destroy the witches' potion, hunt the vampire The Count, cleanse a haunted house, kill the demon Ungreez and, finally, cross the Demon Forge with a large team to destroy the Shadow Nexus. You receive the {wiki:Demon Hunter Outfits|Demon Hunter Outfit} with both addons, one item of your choice out of ten, three achievements and access to the Blessing of the Inquisition.
Deeper areas of the Demon Forge
Mission 7: in each section you kill the boss and enter his teleport (up to 2 minutes later) to unlock the next area, all the way to the Shadow Nexus.
Every teleport unlocked in the Retreat becomes permanent.
When you report the last mission to {npc:Henricus}.
Bought from Henricus: all blessings at once, about 10% more expensive.
